admission.authority: direct user continuation of the main-backed BRC multiplier experiment and round-3 factor-bridge audit
admission.reason: Compose the exact BRC multiplier completion-cost interface with a classical quadratic-residue necessary condition before exact integer squarehood testing.

methods.name: BRC square-gap quadratic-residue prefilter
capabilities: exact packed quadratic-residue table for a declared modulus
zero-false-negative rejection of impossible square gaps
exact integer square-root confirmation on survivors
typed separation of BRC next-square addition cost from ceiling-square Fermat completion cost
immediate square-gap witness surface for classical difference-of-squares composition
methods.core_law: If an integer value is a square then its residue modulo M belongs to the precomputed quadratic-residue mask Q_M. Therefore Q_M[value mod M]=0 safely rejects squarehood before exact isqrt confirmation. For the default M=4032 the mask has 192 live residue classes out of 4032 (uniform fraction 1/21) and a packed mathematical payload of 504 bytes.
methods.hard_boundary: Quadratic-residue filtering, Fermat difference of squares, and Lehman-style multiplier use are classical prior art. Passing the residue filter is not a square certificate. The bounded semiprime benchmark does not imply a factorization speedup or asymptotic complexity result. Coarse BRC basin support/Pell resonance showed no useful within-multiplier pruning signal in the round-3 sample and is not promoted as a selector.
